notes.title: On the Warpath
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30871566/b670c8a918949b2cd9464b62ea37552d18c98b4f.jpg[/img]

Hello there not-so-lovely people!

It’s not often we post about actual game development stuff, mainly because we have no clue what we’re doing, but today that changes. I’ve been asked to talk about some of the development stuff we’ve been up to by the head office...  aka someone who thinks they are in charge of me and will feel my wrath soon enough—but enough about that!

Let’s get straight to business.

The team is hard at work on developing new, tantalisingly tasty stuff, including the sought after feature to battle Mambo AI!

What you’re seeing is called ‘pathfinding’ which is the AI trying to find a character and scanning this maze-y stage. This all happens super quick. The red and black grid is the AI’s mind scanning the area, like a hefty fellow scanning a healthy person’s fridge for some full-fat goodness. Once the AI has located the character, it will then move to where the character is and well, you can guess the rest.

Well, that’s it for today. We’ll have more snippets of polished emptiness for you soon!

—TDK

notes.title: An updated De Mambo build has appeared!
notes.content:
From where you ask? Not sure. It was delivered to us by what seemed like a stork. Once it dropped off this new build into our hands, the stork recited a list. What did the list say you ask? Well, take a look here:

- Multiple controller support major overhaul! Controllers will now automatically order themselves as they are connected for all modes!

- Keyboard and controller configurations also majorly improved!

- Icons and text updates for all controllers!

TDK

notes.title: So It’s Come to This.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30871566/852b2e5bf08cc6fd727090747aa5a3292447856c.jpg[/img]

As you can probably see, De Mambo is out today on Steam Early Access… or this is some crazy fever dream and we should cut down on the illegal paraphernalia—but enough about that!

We just wanted to say hello! How are things? Please don’t answer that as we can’t actually hear you…

Anyway, we’re really looking forward to this brand new relationship with you oh great Steam community and hope you enjoy the ride.

Until next time!

- TDK
